updates.background_zh: 联邦基金期货是在芝加哥商品交易所（CME）交易的合约，反映市场对美国联邦基金利率的预期；CME FedWatch等工具会依据这些期货价格计算加息或降息概率。强于预期的就业报告会提高货币政策收紧的概率，因为美联储可能需要给过热的经济降温。利率上升会使无风险国债资产更具吸引力，并通常会推高美元，从而对以美元计价的比特币和黄金等资产构成压力。比特币在9月历来表现疲软——过去13个9月中有8次收跌，交易员称之为“红色九月”。
updates.background_en: Fed funds futures are exchange-traded contracts on the Chicago Mercantile Exchange that reflect market expectations for the U.S. federal funds rate; tools such as the CME FedWatch calculate the probability of rate moves from these futures prices. A stronger-than-expected jobs report raises the odds of tighter monetary policy, because the Fed may act to cool an overheating economy. Higher interest rates make risk-free Treasury assets more attractive and typically strengthen the dollar, which tends to weigh on dollar-priced assets such as Bitcoin and gold. Bitcoin also has a historical pattern of weakness in September, having closed lower in eight of the last 13 Septembers, a seasonal trend traders call "Red September."
updates.market_impact_zh: 这份报告主要通过利率预期渠道影响加密市场：加息概率上升会推高美债收益率和美元，从而提高持有比特币等无息资产的机会成本，并抑制股票和加密市场的风险偏好。可见的影响是比特币在数据公布几分钟内从82,240美元跌至79,300美元附近；后续关注焦点是9月15-16日的美联储利率决议以及10月2日公布的下一份非农报告。
updates.market_impact_en: This report transmits to crypto markets primarily through the rate-expectations channel: higher hiking odds lift Treasury yields and the dollar, increasing the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding assets like Bitcoin and dampening risk appetite across stocks and crypto. The visible effect was Bitcoin dropping from $82,240 to near $79,300 within minutes of the release; the next focal points are the Fed's September 15-16 decision and the October 2 jobs report.
